Clean up hazards, rescue cute animals, uncover secrets, and upgrade your tools as you explore diverse regions and transform ever-changing islands into beautiful paradises. A World Scarred by Pollution The world has been left scarred by factories and hazards. Islands were left damaged, wildlife has been driven away and places that once felt like paradises have been left desolate. No one else seems willing to do anything about it. But you do care, more than anything. So you set sail to fix what was broken and restore the world. Restore Nature, One Island at a Time Each island starts out damaged by hazards, but the more you clean, the more nature begins to return. Use your special cleaning tools to remove hazards, help cute animals, uncover secrets, and watch each island transform in front of you. Upgrade And Unlock Tools You start slowly at first, but once you start upgrading your tools, the cleaning process becomes much faster. Unlock useful skills and new tools that help you restore new regions. Sometimes, even a small upgrade is all it takes to make a cleanup feel way easier. Explore a World Full of Ever-Changing Islands With 4 unique biomes across 12 distinct maps and a build-in randomizer, you will never visit the same island twice. Each journey leads you to new islands to discover and restore, with beautiful landscapes that make every journey feel fresh and exciting. There is Always A New Contract New cleaning side contracts become available as you progress. Choose between quick cleaning jobs on small islands or put more effort into larger islands for bigger rewards. Every contract generates a new, ever-changing island, offering infinite replayability. Customize Your Boat Your boat stays with you throughout the journey. Change different components, mix and match parts, and make it feel more like your own. Features Explore 4 unique biomes across 12 distinct maps. Restore islands to their natural beauty at your own pace with zero timers. Rescue and pet a variety of cute animals. Clean away hazards using 6 unique satisfying tools. Endless replayability with a build-in randomizer. Unlock powerful upgrades through a skill tree. Take on infinite contracts with ever-changing maps. Customize your boat with unique cosmetic options.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Island Restoration is a cleaning game where you heal a scarred world, one island at a time. Clean up hazards, rescue cute animals, uncover secrets, and upgrade your tools as you explore diverse regions and transform ever-changing islands into beautiful paradises.

A World Scarred by Pollution

The world has been left scarred by factories and hazards. Islands were left damaged, wildlife has been driven away and places that once felt like paradises have been left desolate. No one else seems willing to do anything about it. But you do care, more than anything. So you set sail to fix what was broken and restore the world.

Restore Nature, One Island at a Time

Each island starts out damaged by hazards, but the more you clean, the more nature begins to return. Use your special cleaning tools to remove hazards, help cute animals, uncover secrets, and watch each island transform in front of you.

Upgrade And Unlock Tools

You start slowly at first, but once you start upgrading your tools, the cleaning process becomes much faster. Unlock useful skills and new tools that help you restore new regions. Sometimes, even a small upgrade is all it takes to make a cleanup feel way easier.

Explore a World Full of Ever-Changing Islands

With 4 unique biomes across 12 distinct maps and a build-in randomizer, you will never visit the same island twice. Each journey leads you to new islands to discover and restore, with beautiful landscapes that make every journey feel fresh and exciting.

There is Always A New Contract

New cleaning side contracts become available as you progress. Choose between quick cleaning jobs on small islands or put more effort into larger islands for bigger rewards. Every contract generates a new, ever-changing island, offering infinite replayability.

Customize Your Boat

Your boat stays with you throughout the journey. Change different components, mix and match parts, and make it feel more like your own.

Features

  • Explore 4 unique biomes across 12 distinct maps.

  • Restore islands to their natural beauty at your own pace with zero timers.

  • Rescue and pet a variety of cute animals.

  • Clean away hazards using 6 unique satisfying tools.

  • Endless replayability with a build-in randomizer.

  • Unlock powerful upgrades through a skill tree.

  • Take on infinite contracts with ever-changing maps.

  • Customize your boat with unique cosmetic options.
